items.headline: Nvidia reinstates CEO Jensen Huang after Trump & Vance push; Vance says no pardon needed
items.summary: Trump led the effort and praised Vance on CNBC (“dealing with a Vice President, JD Vance who’s great”); Reuters, The Hill, and CBS News reported Vance also pressed Nvidia board members before Huang’s Nov. 23 return, and Vance told reporters Nov. 25 Huang isn’t under investigation and doesn’t need a pardon.

items.headline: Vance serves Thanksgiving meal to Air Force troops at Wright-Patterson in Ohio
items.summary: Joined by Second Lady Usha Vance and their children in his home state, Vance served Thanksgiving lunch to service members, held off-the-record talks with troops, and fielded press questions afterward.

items.headline: Senate panel opens inquiry into Vance’s ties to Vitol Venezuelan oil contract
items.summary: Incoming Senate Homeland Security chair Maggie Hassan requested Vance’s records by Dec. 14 over a reported Dec. 2025 Montana meeting with donor John Addison before Vitol’s Venezuelan crude license; Vance’s office denied the meeting.
